title: jatropha spathulata var. genuina
intro: Jatropha spathulata var. genuina, commonly known as the "carrizo," is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Jatropha spathulata var. genuina include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, as well as its antipyretic action, which helps to reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
